findings.headline: Server is Slot/Queue-Bound: requests are waiting for KV cache slots.
evidence: TTFT p50 grew 4.6x (391 ms at c=1 to 1800 ms at c=4).
Token decode latency (ITL p50) remained steady (0.0x: 96.8 ms -> 0.1 ms).
Signature indicates requests queue waiting for active slots to finish.
recommendations: Increase server max concurrent sequences / slots (e.g. `--max-num-seqs`).
Enable chunked prefill to interleave prefill with decode iterations.
